task: ae.wasm: WebAssembly integer-MVP binary decoder, validator and interpreter
reasoning_summary: A strict Reader (LEB128 with unused-bit checks, counts checked against remaining bytes before allocation) feeds a section parser and a FunctionCompiler that runs the spec's stack-polymorphic validation while lowering bodies to a flat int array with resolved branch targets (target pc, arity, height). The interpreter is a switch loop over a shared operand stack with traps, call-depth/operand-stack limits and fuel. Tests use literal vectors, per-opcode tables, programs, truncation/byte-flip robustness and an independent BigInteger oracle over random typed expression trees; a 107-mutant pass drove nine extra boundary tests and two code simplifications.
